title: PaperMint
tagline: Enable everyone to manage crypto invoicing easily, powered by 1inch
description: This project help everyone to kickstart a business by managing invoicing process, by helping you making an invoice, track payments, convert the crypto & distribute the funds. Basically, it will help you manage your business easily & saving your time so that you can focus more on your core business.
how_its_made: This project uses react vitejs, tailwind, ConnectKit and 1inch API. It is using typescript language for the web application part and solidity language to enable access to evm blockchain. It mainly use 1inch API as our sponsor that help build this project more secure, better and faster.
